s.note: the wall of fame watches you eat
s.how: Cut 500g pizza dough into 12 strips, tie each into a knot and prove 30 minutes. Bake at 230C for 12 minutes until golden. Melt 50g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and chopped parsley, toss the hot knots through and shower with 30g grated parmesan.

s.note: the only cool thing on the block on the hottest day of the year
s.how: Cut 1kg chilled seedless watermelon into 3cm cubes and 200g firm feta into 2cm cubes. Thread onto 16 skewers, alternating with small mint leaves. Mix 1 tsp flaky salt, half a tsp chilli flakes and the zest of 1 lime. Squeeze the lime juice over the skewers, sprinkle with the chilli salt and serve straight from the fridge.

m.note: pepperoni and extra cheese, straight from the wall of fame
m.how: Rest 2 balls of pizza dough, about 500g, at room temperature for an hour. Season 400g crushed tomatoes with salt and stretch the bases thin. Spread with sauce, top with 250g grated low-moisture mozzarella and 100g pepperoni and bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting for 8 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle with oregano and cut big.

w.note: for the heat on the block
w.how: Simmer 300g cherries, pitted, with 150g caster sugar, 150ml water and the juice of 1 lemon for 10 minutes, then strain and cool the syrup. Shave or crush 1kg ice into four cups and pour the syrup over just before serving.

d.note: Da Mayor and his cold beer on the hottest day of the year
d.how: Make lemonade by stirring 100ml lemon juice, 80g caster sugar and 300ml cold water until dissolved. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Half-fill each glass with ice-cold lager, about 180ml, then top with 100ml of the lemonade. Add a lemon wheel and serve straight away.
